messages:
Emma Zhang: Sapphire Labs sent their vendor risk form during onboarding. Main asks: list of subprocessors, EU->US transfer mechanism, DPA signature vs standard T&Cs, and whether we offer role-based access controls for auditor access. They need answers within 3 business days or they pause provisioning.

Carlos Ruiz: I can assemble the subprocessors list. Priya, can you provide the legal-approved DPA blurb and transfer language?

Priya Nair: Draft blurb below — legal ok but prefer we avoid offering bespoke transfer mechanisms unless enterprise contract: 
`DPA: Redwood provides a standard DPA. Data transfers from EU to US are covered via Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) for Hosted customers; Dedicated/Private customers may keep data in-region. For custom transfer requirements, please request an enterprise amendment.`

Emma Zhang: Good. What about subprocessors? Keep it high level (cloud infra, observability, CDN).

Carlos Ruiz: Subprocessors (high level): Cloud compute provider, object storage, managed DB, CDN provider, metrics/monitoring provider, and SaaS auth provider. Well attach the current list as a separate CSV under NDA.

Priya Nair: RBAC for auditors: we support scoped read-only roles and temporary auditor accounts for Dedicated/Private; Hosted customers can get redacted evidence exports.

SecurityBot: Note: do not promise more than 12 months audit log retention for Hosted without approval.

Emma Zhang: Flagging renewal risk: onboarding hold could push renewal conversation. If provisioning delayed >5 days, escalate to AE.

OnboardBot: Task created: "Respond to Sapphire Labs vendor form" assigned to Emma Zhang & Carlos Ruiz, due 2025-09-12.

Carlos Ruiz: I'll draft the reply now — short bullets, attach subprocessors CSV under NDA, paste Priya's SCC/DPA line, and mention RBAC options. Will post when sent.

Emma Zhang: Thanks team 44d. Paste Sapphire's response here when they reply so we can triage any follow-ups.
